gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.

gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
I only found out the truth because I asked.
gaps.sentence: I wouldn't have found out the truth ___ asked.
gaps.explanation: 'Because I asked' → 'if I hadn't asked' — a third conditional.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.

gaps.lead: Journalists allege that the mayor accepted bribes.
gaps.explanation: 'They allege that he did' becomes 'he is alleged to have done' — passive reporting.

gaps.lead: The match officials postponed the fixture because of the storm.
gaps.sentence: The fixture ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Postpone' = 'put off'; in the passive: the fixture was put off.
